title: Between emergency and reconstruction: Territorial impacts and climate adaptation challenges after hurricane John in Guerrero
summary: This chapter analyses the territorial, human, and socioeconomic impacts caused by Hurricane John (2024) in the state of Guerrero, with a particular focus on the municipalities of Acapulco and Coyuca de Benítez, within a context of increasin
content: This chapter analyses the territorial, human, and socioeconomic impacts caused by Hurricane John (2024) in the state of Guerrero, with a particular focus on the municipalities of Acapulco and Coyuca de Benítez, within a context of increasing intensity and frequency of extreme hydrometeorological events. Using a territorial and comparative approach, the chapter examines the meteorological characteristics of the event, patterns of differentiated impacts, and the structural vulnerability conditions that shaped the magnitude of damage. The findings show that although Hurricane John exhibited lower wind intensity than previous events such as Hurricane Otis (2023), its extraordinary rainfall produced widespread impacts, including flooding, landslides, and significant socioeconomic disruptions, especially in rural and peri-urban areas. Furthermore, the assessment of post-disaster recovery processes reveals persistent structural gaps related to socioeconomic inequality, fragile urban infrastructure, and the limited integration of climate adaptation criteria into territorial planning. Overall, the chapter highlights the urgent need to move toward risk management and resilient reconstruction models that incorporate preventive, participatory, and territorially differentiated approaches, aimed at reducing future exposure and strengthening community adaptive capacity in the face of increasingly extreme climate scenarios.

title: AI, HR Governance, and Human Capital Risk in Indonesia’s Digital Banking: A Systematic Review
summary: While AI is set to make banking faster and better, discussions often overlook its significant impact on human capital and governance. The current literature is still fragmented, largely addressing AI adoption, human resource management (HRM
content: While AI is set to make banking faster and better, discussions often overlook its significant impact on human capital and governance. The current literature is still fragmented, largely addressing AI adoption, human resource management (HRM), and sustainability as independent domains, ignoring the structural risks that develop where they can overlap. This study explicitly addresses this gap by examining how AI simultaneously reorganises HR competencies, creates human capital risks, and necessitates governance practices consistent with sustainability goals. This research employs a systematic literature review (SLR) of 68 peer-reviewed articles obtained from three distinct streams of literature: banking, HRM, and sustainability, using the PRISMA 2020 protocol. Results challenge dominant techno-centric perspectives, suggesting that AI is not simply a tool for boosting productivity but rather an underlying structural driver of both human capital risk—algorithmic bias, lack of transparency and accountability—and worker vulnerability. What is more relevant about the study is that it provides a key takeaway: that without sound HR governance development, AI implementation may undermine organisational legitimacy and have ethical and sustainability impacts. Positioning HR governance as an integrative and corrective mechanism, this study provides a framework linking AI capability, human capital risk, and sustainability. This research provides a different perspective on the literature by shifting the debate around AI-enabled HR transformation from a technological issue to a governance problem that carries multifaceted ramifications toward sustainable digital banking, especially in developing economies such as Indonesia.

title: Algorithm-Driven Sustainable Consumption: Examining the Influence of Social Media Algorithms on Consumer Behavior Through Perceived Green Value and Environmental Awareness
summary: The rapid growth of social media platforms has significantly influenced how consumers access information and make purchasing decisions. This study examines the impact of social media algorithm on consumer behavior, with perceived green valu
content: The rapid growth of social media platforms has significantly influenced how consumers access information and make purchasing decisions. This study examines the impact of social media algorithm on consumer behavior, with perceived green value and environmental awareness serving as mediating variables among consumers in Pakistan. The study investigates how algorithm-driven content shapes consumers’ perceptions of green products, increases environmental awareness, and influences sustainable purchasing behaviour. A quantitative research design was adopted, and data were collected from 360 respondents using a structured questionnaire based on a five-point Likert scale. The data were analyzed using SmartPLS 4 to assess both the measurement and structural models. The structural model showed that all proposed hypotheses were supported. Social media algorithm had significant positive effects on perceived green value (β = 0.681, p < 0.001) and environmental awareness (β = 0.592, p < 0.001). In addition, perceived green value (β = 0.473, p < 0.001) and environmental awareness (β = 0.286, p < 0.001) significantly influenced consumer behavior, while the direct effect of social media algorithm on consumer behavior was also positive and significant (β = 0.162, p = 0.001). The findings highlight the role of social media algorithms in promoting sustainable consumer behavior through enhanced green value perceptions and environmental awareness.

title: OPERATIONALIZATION OF THE INTEGRAL MODEL OF HEALTH IN THE HUMAN-ENVIRONMENT ECOSYSTEM: CRITERIA, VALIDATION, AND DIGITAL BOUNDARIES
summary: The underlying integral model defines health as a dynamic state of integral human existence in interaction with the environment. This study aims to develop a conceptually coherent architecture for operationalizing this definition and a prog
content: The underlying integral model defines health as a dynamic state of integral human existence in interaction with the environment. This study aims to develop a conceptually coherent architecture for operationalizing this definition and a program for its subsequent empirical validation. A conceptual integrative synthesis was conducted across biopsychosocial, salutogenic, functional, capability-based, socio-ecological, humanities-based, public policy, and digital ethics approaches. The unit of analysis is the human-environment system, with the person as the primary agent in assessment and decision-making. Six interrelated criteria were developed: integrity and coherent interaction among dimensions; adaptability; maintenance and restoration of individual balance; functional capacity and agency; viability, self-realization, and generativity; and distributed responsibility. For each criterion, constructs, candidate indicators, data sources, levels of assessment, and risks of misinterpretation were identified. An operational chain linking definition, criterion, construct, indicator, data, assessment, decision, and feedback, together with a six-stage validation program, is proposed. Within this architecture, the healthcare professional acts as a clinical expert, interpreter, partner in shared decision-making, coordinator, and guarantor of safety, without holding exclusive authority over the definition of health. Economic productivity is regarded as an important, but not exhaustive, manifestation of human capacity. The framework establishes requirements for future digital and AI solutions while preserving human judgment.

title: Fraud Detection Beyond Technology: The Role of Auditor Agility
summary: This research was conducted to analyze the impact of information systems, whistleblower systems, and professional skepticism on fraud detection, as well as explore the role of auditor agility moderation. The approach used in this study is a
content: This research was conducted to analyze the impact of information systems, whistleblower systems, and professional skepticism on fraud detection, as well as explore the role of auditor agility moderation. The approach used in this study is a quantitative approach, data that was successfully collected by 197 internal auditor respondents in Indonesia and analyzed through Partial Least Squares–Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM). The results of this study revealed that information systems and whistleblower systems did not significantly affect fraud detection, suggesting that both mechanisms tended to function primarily as operational and compliance support tools rather than strategic fraud detection instruments. Conversely, professional skepticism and auditor agility significantly increase the effectiveness of fraud detection. In the role of moderation, the agility of auditors strengthens the relationship between information systems and fraud detection, but does not moderate the relationship involving the whistleblower system and professional skepticism. These findings highlight that the effectiveness of fraud detection is not only determined by the existence of formal systems or technological infrastructure, but is highly dependent on auditors' adaptive and cognitive abilities. This study contributes to the fraud detection and audit literature by expanding on Dynamic Capability Theory and demonstrating that auditor agility serves as a selective dynamic capability that enhances the effectiveness of technology-based mechanisms in audits.

title: Urbanization, Regional Development, and Economic Inequality: Contemporary Policy Perspectives
summary: While urbanization is reconfiguring income distribution patterns, it can increase or decrease economic inequality depending on local conditions, infrastructure availability, and the stage of urban transition. The paper explores the interact
content: While urbanization is reconfiguring income distribution patterns, it can increase or decrease economic inequality depending on local conditions, infrastructure availability, and the stage of urban transition. The paper explores the interaction between urbanization, regional development, and economic inequality using a stylized balanced panel of 160 regions observed in 2005, 2010, 2015, and 2021, grouped into five regional types. The region and year fixed-effects models are applied along with the region-clustered standard errors, Theil decomposition, and a type-by-year heat map of the urban–rural income ratio. The results indicate that the Gini coefficient and the urban–rural income ratio have an inverted-U relationship with urbanization, with the turning points for the Gini coefficient and the urban–rural income ratio occurring at 57 percent and 61 percent, respectively, of urbanization, after accounting for infrastructure access. Urbanization reduces poverty very strongly, and urbanization in neighboring regions has a similar (negative) effect on poverty as urbanization in the own region. However, the magnitude of regional differences increases from 80.2 to 87.5 percent of the overall Theil index of inequality, with the gap between the coast and frontier regions increasing, while that between urban and rural areas in the industrial regions widens. The paper finds that urbanization is equalizing incomes only through a threshold in infrastructure and institutional development and provides policy suggestions on the issue of infrastructure, housing, connectivity, and place-sensitive governance.

title: Yeşil İnovasyon Araştırmalarının Bibliyometrik Bir Analizi
summary: Amaç –Bu çalışmanın amacı, 2010–2025 yılları arasında yeşil inovasyon, etik ve bilgi yönetimi alanlarında üretilen akademik literatürü bibliyometrik yöntemle inceleyerek araştırma alanının entelektüel yapısını, gelişim eğilimlerini ve temel
content: Amaç –Bu çalışmanın amacı, 2010–2025 yılları arasında yeşil inovasyon, etik ve bilgi yönetimi alanlarında üretilen akademik literatürü bibliyometrik yöntemle inceleyerek araştırma alanının entelektüel yapısını, gelişim eğilimlerini ve temel katkı ağlarını kapsamlı biçimde ortaya koymaktadır.Yöntem –Araştırmada Web of Science Core Collection veri tabanından elde edilen 869 yayından dahil edilme kriterlerini karşılayan 672 çalışma analiz edilmiştir. Analiz süreci veri toplama ve temizleme, performans analizi, iş birliği ağlarının belirlenmesi, tematik haritalama ve bilimsel etki ölçümü aşamalarından oluşmuştur. Bibliyometrik analiz kapsamında atıf, eş-atıf, anahtar kelime eşleşmeleri ve tematik evrim analizleri uygulanmıştır.Bulgular–Yeşil inovasyon araştırmalarının özellikle 2017 sonrasında belirgin bir ivme kazandığını göstermektedir. Çin yayın hacminde lider konumda bulunurken, Birleşik Krallık ve Amerika Birleşik Devletleri yüksek atıf etkileriyle alanın entelektüel merkezini oluşturmaktadır. Journal of Business Ethics en üretken ve en etkili kaynak olarak öne çıkmakta; Technological Forecasting and Social Change ile Journal of Cleaner Production gibi disiplinler arası dergiler yüksek atıf performanslarıyla dikkati çekmektedir. Kurumsal analizlerde University of Manchester, UCL ve bazı önde gelen Çin üniversiteleri üretkenliğiyle ön plana çıkmaktadır. Atıf ve eş-atıf analizleri, literatürün “sürdürülebilirlik”, “çevresel performans”, “etik yönetim”, “yeşil teknoloji” ve “bilgi temelli inovasyon” ekseninde yoğunlaştığını göstermektedir. Tematik evrim haritaları, son yıllarda araştırma gündeminin “döngüsel ekonomi”, “yapay zekâ tabanlı süreçler”, “yeşil dijital dönüşüm” ve “sürdürülebilir tedarik zinciri” gibi daha teknoloji odaklı ve sistematik konulara kaydığını ortaya koymaktadır.Tartışma –Çalışma bulguları, yeşil inovasyonun artık yalnızca çevresel performansla sınırlı olmayan, etik yönetim, bilgi yönetimi, dijital dönüşüm ve sürdürülebilir kalkınma ile doğrudan bağlantılı çok boyutlu bir araştırma alanı haline geldiğini göstermektedir. Alanın entelektüel yapısı giderek daha disiplinler arası bir nitelik kazanmış ve teknoloji odaklı konular ön plana çıkmıştır. Sonuçlar, gelecekteki araştırmaların yapay zekâ destekli bilgi yönetimi, etik denetim mekanizmaları, döngüsel ekonomi stratejileri ve yeşil teknoloji yönetişimi gibi alanlarda yoğunlaşacağını işaret etmektedir. Bu çalışma, alanın bilimsel yapısını bütüncül biçimde haritalandırarak araştırmacılar, politika yapıcılar ve uygulayıcılar için önemli bir referans çerçevesi sunmaktadır

title: Adapting HR Strategies to Enhance CRM in Aviation: A Qualitative Study on Emerging Technologies Grounded in Socio-Technical Systems Theory
summary: Purpose –This study aims to explore how Human Resource Management (HRM) strategies can enhance Crew Resource Management (CRM) effectiveness in the context of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and augmented reality (
content: Purpose –This study aims to explore how Human Resource Management (HRM) strategies can enhance Crew Resource Management (CRM) effectiveness in the context of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) and augmented reality (AR) in aviation. While these technologies improve operational efficiency, they also highlight the critical need for maintaining human oversight and decision-making processes.Design/methodology/approach –The research employs a qualitative methodology grounded in Socio-Technical Systems (STS) theory. Data were collected through interviews with 15 aviation experts, including pilots, HR professionals, and operations managers, and analyzed using thematic analysis with NVivo software.Results–The findings indicate that while automation significantly enhances operational efficiency, maintaining manual skills and human decision-making remains essential for sustainable operations. The study also identifies the need for HR strategies to adapt to technological change through enhanced training programs, continuous learning initiatives, and revised recruitment practices.Discussion –This study contributes to STS theory by emphasizing the importance of balancing technological and social systems to ensure effective CRM in aviation. Practical recommendations for HR strategies are provided, including improving training programs, fosteringa culture of continuous learning, and modernizing recruitment processes to support the successful integration of emerging technologies in aviation

title: Havacılık Sektöründe Tedarik Zinciri Yönetiminin İş Performansına Etkiler
summary: Amaç –Çalışmada Türkiye’de sivil havacılık sektörünün merkezi olarak görülen İstanbul il sınırları içinde faaliyet gösteren havacılık işletmelerinde, tedarik zinciri uygulamalarının iş performanslarına etkilerinin incelenmesi ve yorumlanmas
content: Amaç –Çalışmada Türkiye’de sivil havacılık sektörünün merkezi olarak görülen İstanbul il sınırları içinde faaliyet gösteren havacılık işletmelerinde, tedarik zinciri uygulamalarının iş performanslarına etkilerinin incelenmesi ve yorumlanması amaçlanmaktadır.Yöntem–Kantitatif araştırma yönteminin uygulandığı çalışmada veri toplama yöntemi olarak anketten yararlanılmıştır. Çalışmada tedarik zinciri yönetiminin iş performansına etkileri incelenerek tanımsal olarak da bir neticeye ulaşılacağından kesitsel araştırmalar grubu dâhilinde bulunan nicel anket araştırma kısmında da dâhildir. Çalışmanın evren büyüklüğü rakamsal olarak bilindiğinden %5 örneklem hatasında göre minimum örneklem büyüklüğü dikkate alınmıştır. Araştırma evreni olarak 2022 yılsonu itibariyle Türkiye’deki sivil havacılık sektörü çalışanları seçilmiştir. Bunun neticesinde de on-line olarak uygulanan ankete verilen cevaplardan kabul edilebilir 359 adedi inceleme ve yorumlamaya dâhil edilmiştir. Hazırlanan anket üç kısımdan oluşmaktadır. İlk kısımda araştırmaya katılanların demografik özelliklerinin belirlenmesine yönelik sorular bulunmaktadır. İkinci kısımda 17 sorudan oluşan tedarik zinciri performansı ölçeğine yönelik ifadeler yer almaktadır. Üçüncü kısımda ise 11 ifadeden oluşan iş performansı ölçeğine ait sorular bulunmaktadır. Ön test grubuna uygulanan ölçekler alınan doğru sonuçlar neticesinde dijital ortamda yeniden düzenlenerek asıl çalışma grubuna 15.03.2025 –25.03.2025 tarihleri arasında on-line olarak uygulanmıştır. İlgili anket Türkiye’de sivil havacılık sektöründe farklı çalışma alanlarında hizmet veren şirketlerdeki beyaz yakalı ofis çalışanlarına uygulanmıştır. Uygulama neticesinde elde edilen veriler ise SPSS 26.0 ve AMOS 24.0 programlarından faydalanılarak analiz edilmiştir.Bulgular–Çalışma Türkiye’deki sivil havacılık sektörü çalışanları üzerinde yapılmıştır. İlgili alanda tedarik zinciri performansı ile bunun yönetilmesinin iş performansı üzerindeki etkilerinin incelenmesi neticesinde bağlı faktörler arasındaki ilişkinin ortaya çıkarılması sağlanmıştır. Araştırma değişkenleri vasıtası ile yapılan korelasyon analizleri neticesinde bütün değişkenlerin aralarında anlamlı ilişkilerin olduğu anlaşılmıştır. Özellikle görev performansı alt boyutu ile bağlamsal performans arasındabulunan ilişkinin en yüksek olan etkileşime sahip olduğu görülmüştür. Sonuçta sivil havacılık sektöründe çalışanların sahip oldukları görev performanslarının bağlamsal performans boyutu ile kuvvetli bir etkileşime sahip olduğu da anlaşılmaktadır. Diğer bir bulgu ise tedarik zinciri alt boyutlarının iş performansı alt boyutları üzerinde anlamlı etkiye sahip olduklarıdır. Tedarik zinciri performansı alt boyutlarından olan esneklik faktörünün iş performansı faktörlerinden olan görev performansı alt boyutu üzerinde en büyük etkiye sahip olduğu ortaya çıkarılmıştır. Yine yapılan modelin açıklama gücünün yeterince kuvvetli olduğu ve en güçlü etkiye görev performansı faktörünün sahip olduğu anlaşılmaktadı

title: Climate Change Knowledge, Perceptions and Smallholder Farmers’ Behavioral Intention to Adopt Crop Insurance in Hanang District, Tanzania: A PLS-SEM Approach
summary: Climate change remains a global concern; farmers in rain-fed agricultural regions, including Tanzania, face significant exposure to its adverse effects. Crop insurance has been promoted as a climate change adaptation tool, yet uptake remain
content: Climate change remains a global concern; farmers in rain-fed agricultural regions, including Tanzania, face significant exposure to its adverse effects. Crop insurance has been promoted as a climate change adaptation tool, yet uptake remains low. Existing studies identify barriers: affordability, trust, awareness, access and basis risk. Evidence on whether climate change knowledge (KCC) and perception (PCC) influence intention to adopt crop insurance (ACI), directly or indirectly, remains mixed and understudied. Guided by the Theory of Planned Behaviour (TPB), this study posits KCC and PCC as TPB background factors and assesses their influence on intention to ACI. Primary data were collected from 374 smallholder farmers randomly selected across the five divisions of Hanang District. PLS-SEM with a reflective-reflective measurement approach was used for data analysis. Findings: KCC was positively associated with ACI and was strongly associated with PCC. PCC partially mediates the relationship between KCC and ACI, accounting for 56.4% of the total effect. The findings suggest that KCC influences intention largely by shaping how farmers perceive climate risk and, therefore, influences intention to ACI. Practically, the study recommends prioritising KCC and PCC programmes supported by localised climate information; integrating climate change and insurance education into extension programmes/training; and enabling extension officers to deliver education and link farmers with climate-risk stakeholders. Further studies should use a longitudinal design across more ecological zones; include the core TPB constructs; and examine how intention translates into actual crop insurance adoption. SDG ALIGNMENT: This study contributes to Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) 1, 8 and 13 (UN General Assembly, 2015). By identifying ways to increase crop insurance uptake, it supports SDG 1 (No Poverty) through protecting smallholder farm incomes from climate losses, advances SDG 8 (Decent Work and Economic Growth – 8.10) by informing insurers’ and financial institutions’ efforts to expand insurance access among rain-fed smallholder farmers, and SDG 13 (Climate Action) by evidencing how climate change knowledge, largely through farmers’ perception of climate risk, is associated with intention to adopt crop insurance, the role of climate education and awareness in adaptation.

title: Isolation and Molecular Characterization of Enterotoxigenic Strains of Staphylococcus aureus in Raw Milk from District Kasur, Punjab, Pakistan
summary: This research aimed to isolate and molecularly characterize Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) from raw milk. We collected 600 raw milk samples from commercial dairy farms, milk collection centers, and Gawalas (200 samples each) in Kasur Dis
content: This research aimed to isolate and molecularly characterize Staphylococcus aureus (S. aureus) from raw milk. We collected 600 raw milk samples from commercial dairy farms, milk collection centers, and Gawalas (200 samples each) in Kasur District, Punjab, Pakistan. S. aureus was identified in 270 (45%) of the samples using culture techniques. Raw milk from Gawalas had the highest prevalence, with 110 (55%) positive samples, followed by 90 (45%) from milk collection centers and 70 (35%) from commercial dairy farms. The S. aureus isolates that tested positive for enterotoxin genes were further characterized using PCR. In raw milk from commercial dairy farms, the enterotoxin C gene was detected in 42.86% of samples, while the A and B genes were present in 28.57% each. In raw milk from collection centers, the enterotoxin A gene was found in 42.86% of samples, and the B and C genes in 28.57% each. In Gawala's raw milk, the enterotoxin A gene was present in 50% of samples, while the B and C genes were present in 30% and 20% of samples, respectively. Overall, enterotoxin genes A, B, and C were identified in 41.67%, 29.17%, and 29.17% of the samples, respectively. This study found a significant incidence of enterotoxigenic S. aureus in raw milk from Gawlas, indicating that unsanitary milking practices increase the risk of milk-borne diseases, and recommends implementing pasteurization.

title: Munzur Üniversitesi Nadir Toprak Elementleri Operasyonel Programı ve Güncel Durum
summary: "Munzur University’s Rare Earth Elements (REE) Operational Program addresses Türkiye’s R&D, product development, education, capacity-building, and regional development objectives in the fields of strategic raw materials and advanced technol
content: "Munzur University’s Rare Earth Elements (REE) Operational Program addresses Türkiye’s R&D, product development, education, capacity-building, and regional development objectives in the fields of strategic raw materials and advanced technology applications through a holistic approach. Within the scope of Munzur University’s regional development-oriented mission differentiation, its area of specialization has been defined as “Strategic Raw Materials and Advanced Technology Applications.” Accordingly, rare earth elements, critical minerals, advanced materials, recycling, chemical purification, environmentally friendly production, and the development of high valueadded technological products have become priority areas of work. The project titled “Enhancing the Research and Innovation Capacity of Türkiye in Rare Earth Elements,” co-financed by the European Union and the Republic of Türkiye, aims to contribute to the establishment of a sustainable REE supply chain in Türkiye. The final beneficiary of the project is the General Directorate of Industry (SGM), while its partners are Munzur University Rare Earth Elements Application and Research Center (MUNTEAM) and the General Directorate of Mineral Research and Exploration (MTA). Within the scope of the project, the MUNTEAM building was allocated, laboratory infrastructure was established, research partnerships were developed, and the center began carrying out activities in analysis, accreditation, education, R&D, product development, and business development. The current status of the program is not limited solely to the establishment of laboratory infrastructure. Projects supported by The Scientific and Technological Research Council of Türkiye (TUBITAK), the Presidency of Strategy and Budget, and collaborations with various universities cover a wide range of fields, including ore enrichment, chemical purification, solvent extraction, bioleaching, recycling, advanced alloys, optoelectronic materials, catalysts, biomedical applications, and data analytics. In addition, training programs for R&D professionals, the critical minerals optimization team, and data science and artificial intelligence-based analytical approaches strengthen the program’s human resource capacity and methodological competence. As a result, Munzur University’s REE Operational Program holds a strategic position in terms of Türkiye’s critical mineral independence, green transition, defense industry, e-mobility, digital technologies, and circular economy objectives. Internationalization, accreditation, open innovation, industrial integration, and the establishment of new graduate programs and institutes are of critical importance for the sustainability of the program."

title: Swifty Sends Signals - Towards Inspirational Digital Travel Assistants with Trustworthiness
summary: The emergence of inspirational Digital Travel Assistants (DTAs) represents a promising shift in the tourism industry toward conversational travel planning and booking, yet their design remains underinvestigated in academic literature. We ex
content: The emergence of inspirational Digital Travel Assistants (DTAs) represents a promising shift in the tourism industry toward conversational travel planning and booking, yet their design remains underinvestigated in academic literature. We explore how to convert travel intentions into committed bookings through interactions with conversational assistants, and the role of trustworthiness therein. Using a DSR approach, we present Swifty, an inspirational DTA developed with this capability and deployed as a public pilot by the Lufthansa Group. Data stem from a large-scale evaluation comparing Swifty against a baseline, the conventional website (N=887), alongside semi-structured interviews with test users (N=11) and product owners (N=3). We offer two contributions: First, we demonstrate a conversion gap within the "inspirational episode" of conversational travel planning. Second, we derive actionable design principles to support trustworthiness in inspirational DTAs, grounded in the inspiration framework of Thrash and Elliot (2004) and the ABI model of Mayer et al. (1995).

title: When (Not) to Trust AI: An Interpretable Approach to Assessing Machine Learning Predictions
summary: Artificial intelligence has become pervasive across business, society, and research. In particular, the predictions of machine learning (ML) models are used for decision support in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and finance. However
content: Artificial intelligence has become pervasive across business, society, and research. In particular, the predictions of machine learning (ML) models are used for decision support in high-stakes domains such as healthcare and finance. However, ML model predictions are naturally not always correct, and false ML model predictions can have severe consequences. We propose U-EXPLORE, a novel approach for reject/trust-decisions of ML model predictions which aims to facilitate improved AI-augmented decision-making. U-EXPLORE reconstructs the decision behavior of ML models and develops a set of strongly performing ML models to exploit model multiplicity. The reject/trust-decision is based on three risk factors, thus highlighting why a prediction was rejected or trusted. An evaluation on four real-world datasets from high-stakes domains shows that U-EXPLORE provides strong decision accuracy and outperforms competing approaches. In addition, due to its interpretability, U-EXPLORE not only enhances transparency, but also can facilitate the improvement of ML models.

title: Financing the Green Transition in Developing Nations: Investment Requirements, Capital Mobilization, and Climate-Compatible Growth
summary: This report examines the financing architecture required to accelerate the green transition across developing nations, analyzing investment requirements, the cost-of-capital problem, domestic resource mobilization, multilateral development
content: This report examines the financing architecture required to accelerate the green transition across developing nations, analyzing investment requirements, the cost-of-capital problem, domestic resource mobilization, multilateral development banks, climate funds, blended finance, green bonds, and debt sustainability. Applying the H Heuristics Development Multiplier framework, it evaluates how coordinated financing mechanisms can unlock climate-compatible growth without accumulating unsustainable debt burdens.

title: Pengaruh Risiko Kredit Dan Efisiensi Operasional Terhadap Kinerja Keuangan Perbankan Di Indonesia Periode Tahun 2020-2024
summary: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh risiko kredit dan efisiensi operasional terhadap kinerja keuangan pada perusahaan subsektor perbankan yang terdaftar di Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) periode 2020–2024. Berdasarkan fenomena ya
content: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk mengetahui pengaruh risiko kredit dan efisiensi operasional terhadap kinerja keuangan pada perusahaan subsektor perbankan yang terdaftar di Bursa Efek Indonesia (BEI) periode 2020–2024. Berdasarkan fenomena yang memberlatar belakangi terlihat adanya perubahan tingkat kredit bermasalah pada NPL, efisiensi operasional dan kinerja keuangan. Populasi dalam penelitian ini berjumlah 47 perusahaan perbankan yang terdaftar di Bursa Efek Indonesia. Teknik pengambilan sampel menggunakan purposive sampling sehingga diperoleh 20 perusahaan sebagai sampel penelitian. Metode analisis yang digunakan adalah analisis regresi linier berganda dengan bantuan program Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS).Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa persamaan regresi linier berganda yang diperoleh adalah Y =6,307 + -1,352X₁ + 0,414X₂ + e. Hasil uji t menunjukkan bahwa risiko kredit secara parsial tidak berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kinerja keuangan dengan nilai t hitung sebesar -1,156 < t tabel sebesar 1,984 dan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,251 > 0,05. Sementara itu, efisiensi operasional secara parsial berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kinerja keuangan dengan nilai t hitung sebesar 4,185 > t tabel sebesar 1,984 dan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,000 < 0,05. Hasil uji F menunjukkan bahwa risiko kredit dan efisiensi operasional secara simultan berpengaruh signifikan terhadap kinerja keuangan dengan nilai F hitung sebesar 9,365 > F tabel sebesar 3,09 dan nilai signifikansi sebesar 0,000 < 0,05. Hasil uji koefisien determinasi (R²) sebesar 0,162 menunjukkan bahwa risiko kredit dan efisiensi operasional mampu menjelaskan kinerja keuangan sebesar 16,2%, sedangkan sisanya sebesar 83,8% dijelaskan oleh faktor lain di luar penelitian. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa variabel efisiensi operasional merupakan variabel yang signifikan dalam model, sedangkan sebagian besar variasi kinerja keuangan dijelaskan oleh faktor lain di luar model.

title: DRIVERS OF SUSTAINABLE APPAREL PURCHASE INTENTIONS AMONG INDIAN CONSUMERS: INSIGHTS INTO CONSCIOUS CONSUMERISM
source: TMP Universal Journal of Research and Review Archives.
summary: Concerns about the ecological and social effects of the global fashion business have been growing in recent years, and there is a growing focus on sustainable apparel consumption. Environmental awareness, evolving consumer lifestyles and th
content: Concerns about the ecological and social effects of the global fashion business have been growing in recent years, and there is a growing focus on sustainable apparel consumption. Environmental awareness, evolving consumer lifestyles and the impact of conscious consumerism are gradually reshaping purchasing behaviour in the Indian apparel sector. The present paper examines sustainable apparel purchase intentions of Indian consumers with reference to their awareness, attitudes and influencing factors towards sustainable clothing products. The study is based on a review of existing literature related to sustainable fashion, green consumer behaviour, ethical consumption & conscious consumerism. Identify major determinants affecting on sustainable apparel purchasing intentions such as environmental concern, social responsibility, product quality, price sensitivity, brand image, consumer knowledge and cultural values. The review also identifies barriers such as low awareness, high product cost, limited access and scepticism to sustainability claims. This study is conceptual and exploratory in nature and is based on secondary data sources like journal articles, reports and scholarly publications. In the past few years, there has been an upsurge in voices expressing concerned concerning the social and environmental consequences of the international fashion industry. The paper concludes that there is a need for organisations, policymakers and marketers to improve sustainability communication, affordability, transparency and consumer education to promote conscious apparel consumption in India. This research gives useful information to the environmentally friendly fashion sector and adds to the growing body of published work on sustainable customer behaviour in developing nations.

title: Explaining the Gap Between Women’s Descriptive and Substantive Representation in South Sudan
summary: Policy and institutional gains accompanied these numerical advances, including gender provisions in the Transitional Constitution, the National Gender Policy, R-ARCSS quota commitments, the Parliamentary Women’s Caucus, Women’s Peace Huts a
content: Policy and institutional gains accompanied these numerical advances, including gender provisions in the Transitional Constitution, the National Gender Policy, R-ARCSS quota commitments, the Parliamentary Women’s Caucus, Women’s Peace Huts and other gender mechanisms. Objective: This article examines the persistent gap between women’s descriptive representation and substantive political power in South Sudan. Methods: Drawing on a mixed-methods sequential explanatory study of 314 participants across Juba, Wau and Malakal, it analyses whether the expansion of women’s presence in political institutions has translated into policy influence, institutional authority and transformation of the rules through which power is exercised. Sustainable gender equality requires movement beyond numerical targets towards enforceable authority, budgetary capacity, institutional redesign and accountability for substantive outcomes. Results: The empirical evidence documents substantial gains in descriptive representation: women’s representation in the National Parliament rose from 24.5% in 2011 to 32.4% in 2024; ministerial representation increased from 18.2% to 25.7%; and women’s presence in county commissioner positions more than doubled from 8.9% to 18.7%. Only a minority of respondents considered increased representation to have produced significant policy change for women, while 67.8% of women in government positions reported insufficient resources, authority or institutional support to implement policy agendas effectively. Conclusion: Yet the evidence simultaneously reveals a representation–power gap.

title: Alexithymia and ill-being and well-being: The role of emotion regulation.
summary: Alexithymia is an important risk factor for psychopathology . However, it is not yet clear why. Here, we examine alexithymia ’s relationship with both ill-being and well-being outcomes and test whether emotion regulation patterns are a key
content: Alexithymia is an important risk factor for psychopathology . However, it is not yet clear why. Here, we examine alexithymia ’s relationship with both ill-being and well-being outcomes and test whether emotion regulation patterns are a key mechanism explaining these links. Based on contemporary affective science frameworks, we predicted that people high (vs. low) in alexithymia would more frequently use maladaptive emotion regulation strategies that involve disengaging from negative emotions and less frequently use adaptive strategies that involve engaging with negative emotions. We also predicted that emotion regulation strategy choice should, in turn, statistically mediate relationships between alexithymia and ill- and well-being. We conducted two cross-sectional survey studies with mediation modeling, one exploratory ( N = 427) and one preregistered ( N = 600). In both studies, results indicated that (a) alexithymia is associated with higher ill-being and lower well-being, (b) alexithymia is associated with greater use of maladaptive disengagement emotion regulation strategies and less use of adaptive engagement strategies, and (c) the relationships between alexithymia and ill- and well-being outcomes are statistically partially explained by this profile of emotion regulation. Conceptually, these findings are well aligned with the attention–appraisal model of alexithymia and process model of emotion regulation , empirically supporting the claim that interactions between alexithymia and emotion regulation have important implications for people’s ill-being and well-being. Clinically, these findings highlight the importance of targeting both alexithymia and emotion regulation patterns in treatment to help facilitate desirable affective outcomes. Our findings suggest that such work may help reduce ill-being and enhance well-being.

title: Safety Climate Perception Gaps Across Job Roles in Multinational Construction Workforces: Evidence from Saudi Arabia
source: Islamic University Journal of Applied Sciences
summary: Safety performance in construction is strongly influenced by how workers understand and respond to safety practices, particularly in complex and multicultural work environments. Although safety climate has been widely studied, limited atten
content: Safety performance in construction is strongly influenced by how workers understand and respond to safety practices, particularly in complex and multicultural work environments. Although safety climate has been widely studied, limited attention has been given to how these perceptions differ across job roles in multinational construction settings. This study examines variations in safety climate perceptions across job roles within a multinational construction workforce. A survey was conducted with 256 construction workers representing different occupational groups. The study focused on key safety climate dimensions, including management commitment, supervisory practices, safety training, and individual responsibility for safety and health. Data were analyzed using reliability and validity tests, descriptive statistics, and one-way ANOVA. Overall, workers across the different occupational groups reported comparable views on several aspects of safety climate. However, differences became more noticeable when workers evaluated supervisory safety practices. Frontline and skilled workers, in particular, tended to describe less positive day-to-day supervisory safety experiences than other job groups. These findings suggest that supervisory interactions may not be experienced consistently across all levels of the workforce.

title: Application of Team-Based Learning in Green Infrastructure Education: An Active and Interdisciplinary Approach to Sustainable Engineering
source: Journal of Sustainable Development of Energy Water and Environment Systems
summary: Team-based learning has been increasingly applied in engineering education as an active learning methodology to enhance student engagement and interdisciplinary collaboration. This study evaluates the implementation of team-based learning i
content: Team-based learning has been increasingly applied in engineering education as an active learning methodology to enhance student engagement and interdisciplinary collaboration. This study evaluates the implementation of team-based learning in a graduate-level Green Infrastructure course and analyses its impact on student performance and perceptions. The methodology involved individual assessments, team discussions, and a final Class Evaluation Form to measure student engagement and learning outcomes. Results indicate that team-based assessments significantly outperformed individual assessments, reinforcing the effectiveness of peer learning. Students’ feedback highlighted high engagement, the topic’s relevance, and the instructor’s essential role in facilitating discussion. These findings suggest that team-based learning fosters a more interactive and meaningful learning environment, making it a valuable approach for engineering education, particularly in interdisciplinary and sustainability-focused courses. Future studies could explore long-term knowledge retention and professional skill development through team-based learning.

title: Human-aware robot navigation in public space based on predicting pedestrian reaction patterns
source: Advances in Science and Technology – Research Journal
summary: This paper presents a human-aware collision free navigation system based on long-term motion prediction and a game against nature formulation for modelling uncertainty. The proposed approach explicitly takes into account mutual pedestrian i
content: This paper presents a human-aware collision free navigation system based on long-term motion prediction and a game against nature formulation for modelling uncertainty. The proposed approach explicitly takes into account mutual pedestrian interactions and introduces a method for estimating the confidence of predicted pedestrian reactions through the analysis of anticipated interactions in public spaces. This enables the formulation of a decision-making framework based on the minimisation of the expected value of a cost function. The effectiveness of the method proposed is demonstrated using representative simulation scenarios, showing improved safety and enhanced comfort of navigation behaviour.

title: New prediction model for school dropout based on an improvement of SVM and ABC optimization algorithm
source: International Journal of Informatics and Communication Technology (IJ-ICT)
summary: School dropout is a major dare for Moroccan education systems. It generates profound repercussions, both socially and economically, affecting both individuals and the entire community. To assess the risks associated with this phenomenon, it
content: School dropout is a major dare for Moroccan education systems. It generates profound repercussions, both socially and economically, affecting both individuals and the entire community. To assess the risks associated with this phenomenon, it is essential to use innovative technologies, relying in particular on statistical methods and artificial intelligence models capable of providing effective results using available data. These methods offer the possibility of identifying the factors influencing the educational phenomenon and anticipating the associated risks. To understand the effect of scholars’ social, economic, and personal influences on school dropout, we propose in this work a new classifier, based on an improvement of support vector machines (SVM) and on the ABC algorithm. We also present a regression model designed to estimate academic performance based on the average grade obtained. We also propose a new regression model to predict the degree of academic achievement. The proposed model was validated on a real dataset, compiled from a questionnaire distributed to Moroccan secondary school students. Furthermore, several comparative studies were conducted with recent approaches to assess the performance of the proposed methods. All the experimental results confirm the robustness and improved performance of the developed methods, particularly with respect to accuracy and predictive capability.

title: GREEN ECONOMY PRACTICES PADA UMKM BAKERY : EKSPLORASI STRATEGI, TANTANGAN DAN KINERJA USAHA DI JAWA TIMUR
source: WORLDVIEW ( Jurnal Ekonomi Bisnis dan Sosial Sains )
summary: This study explores green economy practices among bakery micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in East Java, focusing on implementation strategies, adoption challenges, and implications for business performance. A qualitative c
content: This study explores green economy practices among bakery micro, small, and medium-sized enterprises (MSMEs) in East Java, focusing on implementation strategies, adoption challenges, and implications for business performance. A qualitative case study design was employed. Data were gathered through semi-structured interviews, non-participant observation, and business documentation involving bakery MSME owners or managers and relevant supporting informants. The results indicate that green economy practices in these bakery MSMEs are manifested through energy efficiency, food waste reduction, conservation of raw materials and water, container reuse, waste sorting, and the use of eco-friendly packaging. Implementation strategies primarily involve aligning production volume with demand, optimizing the use of equipment and raw materials, and responding to customer preferences for environmentally friendly practices. Key obstacles identified include limited capital, the relatively high cost of technology and eco-friendly packaging, material availability, employee habits, and limited knowledge. The findings also show that the most consistently realized benefits are cost efficiency, waste reduction, and increased productivity, whereas the impact on revenue growth cannot yet be directly attributed to these practices. In some instances, green economy practices also contribute to business image, customer loyalty, and repeat orders. Conceptually, the adoption of green economy practices among bakery MSMEs tends to evolve from efficiency-focused measures toward differentiation strategies driven by customer response.

title: Remodeling and Application of Stock Option Price Based on Skewed Laplace Distribution Approach
source: CAUCHY Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi
summary: This paper proposed a new model to price a stock option based on the Skewed Laplace distribution approach (SLOP). The approach was considered to provide a better option price than Black Scholes Option Price (BSOP) because Skewed Laplace dis
content: This paper proposed a new model to price a stock option based on the Skewed Laplace distribution approach (SLOP). The approach was considered to provide a better option price than Black Scholes Option Price (BSOP) because Skewed Laplace distribution (SL) has a shape parameter that can capture excess skewness and kurtosis frequently found in stock return underlying the option price. In this study, SL’s shape parameter was estimated using a mixture of the Moment Method and Fourth-Order Taylor Series approach. The estimator was different from the majority of prior SL’s shape parameter that was obtained by Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE). The proposed shape parameter was easier to obtain relative to the prior parameter because it did not require a Likelihood Function (LH) and the maximization of LH where involved a complicated numerical method. The performance of SLOP was applied to eleven different enterprises that trade stock options at several strike prices. According to the empirical results in this research, it can be summarized that the SL approach yields a better option price model rather than Black Scholes (BS).
